description: Search and look up movies, TV shows, people, and trending titles on The Movie Database.

auth.label: API Read Access Token
auth.description: TMDB API Read Access Token sent as an Authorization Bearer token. Create or copy it from TMDB API settings: https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api. Use the Read Access Token, not the short v3 API key.

actions.name: get_configuration
actions.description: Get TMDB image base URLs, available image sizes, and change keys used to build media URLs.

inputSchema.description: No input is required for TMDB configuration.

images.description: Image configuration used to construct TMDB image URLs.

change_keys.description: Change-tracking keys used by TMDB change feeds.

outputSchema.description: TMDB API configuration used to build image URLs and interpret change keys.

actions.name: get_movie

id.description: TMDB numeric identifier for this result.

anyOf.description: Runtime in minutes.

homepage.description: Official homepage URL when TMDB provides one.

production_countries.description: Production countries associated with the movie.

actions.name: list_trending
actions.description: List movies, TV shows, and people currently trending on TMDB for a day or week window.

mediaType.description: Media type to include in the trending list.

timeWindow.description: Trending time window used by TMDB.

language.description: ISO-639-1 language code with an optional ISO-3166-1 region, such as en-US.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing TMDB trending titles.

page.description: Current page number returned by TMDB.

media_type.description: Media type for mixed lists such as trending, for example movie, tv, or person.

name.description: TV show or person name when the result is not a movie.

overview.description: Plot summary for a movie or TV show.

original_language.description: Original language code returned by TMDB.

original_name.description: Original TV show or person name.

adult.description: Whether TMDB marks the result as adult content.

genre_ids.description: TMDB genre identifiers associated with this result.

results.description: Result items for this page. An empty array is valid when nothing matches.

total_results.description: Total number of matching results returned by TMDB.
